headline: Closing the follow-ups you've already sent now runs on its own each weekday morning, as its own quiet background task — so they stop showing up as still-owed. Your morning brief just reads the result. If that task ever runs late, the brief now says 'you may have already handled this' instead of telling you to redo it. Nothing for you to set up; the catch-up of anything already sent happens automatically on the first run.
